IRS Form 2848 (Power of Attorney): 31 C.F.R. Part 10 (Circular 230). CONFIRMED 2026-08-29 via IRS.gov: unlimited representation rights before the IRS are limited to attorneys, CPAs, and Enrolled Agents (EAs). A plain PTIN-only preparer without AFSP completion generally cannot use this form for full representation -- verify the preparer's EA credential before enabling this document type for a given tenant.
Offer in Compromise (IRS Form 656 / Form: Same Circular 230 representation-rights caution as IRS Form 2848 -- verify credential before enabling.
IRC Section 7216 Consent Form: 26 U.S.C. Section 7216 -- applies to any paid tax return preparer regardless of credential.

Document Delivery Receipts: 31 C.F.R. Section 10.28(a) (Circular 230, Return of Client's Records). CONFIRMED 2026-08-29 via eCFR/Cornell Law. Applies only if the preparer is an actual Circular 230 'practitioner' (CPA, attorney, EA, or AFSP-completion preparer acting within that limited scope) -- a plain PTIN-only preparer with no EA/AFSP status is likely not covered. Do not apply blindly; check the specific preparer's credential first.
